external_collaboration.evidence_quote: During the 2019 National Association of Realtors® annual Conference & Expo, the National Association of REALTORS®’ Board of Directors approved MLS Statement 8.0, also known as the Clear Cooperation policy. The policy requires listing brokers who are participants in a multiple listing service to submit their listing to the MLS within one business day of marketing the property to the public.

On May 1, 2020, NEREN began compliance with NAR’s Clear Cooperation policy, which promotes great access to available for-sale properties to brokers and consumers. Following is a presentation by NEREN CEO Joe Ryan.
